subject: Invoice-led onboarding: temporary no-PO for pilot request
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@ledgerlytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@ledgerlytics.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot kickoff — request for invoice-first onboarding (no PO for first 60 days)

Hi Hannah / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at LedgerLytics is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. One quick procurement question on our side: our internal procurement cycle can take 6–8 weeks for new suppliers. To avoid blocking the pilot, would Redwood consider an invoice-led onboarding for the initial 60 days (we pay invoices net 30) without a formal PO on file?

We can provide W-9, a vendor contact, and a short commercial agreement (signed). Our finance team copied here is comfortable with this approach for pilots at our size, and they asked me to surface it with you.

If there are controls Redwood needs (evidence, limits, payment schedule), please let me know — we want to be compliant but also move fast.

Attaching our vendor intake form and a short FOA we typically sign (PDF).

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Carter
Head of Partnerships, LedgerLytics
liam.carter@ledgerlytics.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: vendor_intake_ledgerlytics.pdf (PDF), ledgerlytics_foa_signed.pdf (PDF)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@ledgerlytics.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — request for invoice-first onboarding (no PO for first 60 days)

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and for sending the intake materials.

Short answer: we can usually accommodate a temporary invoice-first onboarding for pilots, provided Finance is comfortable with a limited provisional arrangement and we capture some guardrails. To move forward I need to confirm three things with you: 

1) Maximum spend cap for the pilot period (we typically ask for a provisional cap so we can route exceptions quickly).
2) Signed minimal commercial terms / FOA (we can accept your FOA as long as it doesn't conflict with our core T&Cs).
3) Billing contact and remit instructions (so we can preclear the vendor record).

If you can confirm those, I'll loop in Procurement for a quick provisional exception approval. Priya — can you advise what evidence Finance needs for a 60-day no-PO exception (W-9 + signed FOA + cap OK?). Grace — flagging for CS to confirm expected usage shape so we can propose a cap.

I'll prepare a one-page provisional no-PO agreement we can both sign to formalize this.

Best,
Hannah
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Liam Carter <liam.carter@ledgerlytics.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — request for invoice-first onboarding (no PO for first 60 days)

Hi all — finance side here. We can approve a time-bound, invoice-led onboarding for pilots under the following minimum controls: 

• Provision cap: $12,500 total for the 60-day pilot (we can set alerts at 75% and 90%).
• Evidence: completed W-9 (good), signed FOA (need confirmation there are no conflicting terms).
• Payment: net 30 from invoice date, remit instructions required before first invoice.
• Risk: no automatic renewals — if LedgerLytics wants to continue past the pilot we require a PO or a contract signed by Redwood legal.

If LedgerLytics agrees to the cap and to the non-renewal clause, we can issue a provisional vendor record and a short "Provisional No-PO Agreement" for signatures. We'll also require the vendor to use a dedicated billing email for invoices (we prefer invoices@ledgerlytics.com).

Liam — if you can confirm the cap is acceptable and resend the FOA as a docx (we need to run it through our legal quick-check), I will start the exception approval and post the approval code here.

Thanks,
Priya
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — request for invoice-first onboarding (no PO for first 60 days)

Liam — thank you. Per Priya's note, Redwood can proceed with a 60-day invoice-led onboarding under these agreed items: 

• Spend cap: $12,500 total for the pilot period.
• Documents: W-9 received (attached), FOA reviewed — please send as editable DOCX so our legal can quick-review; we will not accept terms that create evergreen obligations.
• Non-renewal: no automatic renewal; continuation requires a PO or signed Redwood contract.
• Billing: invoices to invoices@ledgerlytics.com with remit instructions; net 30 terms.
• Provisional agreement: attached Provisional_no-PO_agreement.docx for signature.

Attached: Redwood onboarding packet (LedgerLytics_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf) and the provisional agreement draft (Provisional_no-PO_agreement.docx). Please review and sign the DocuSign link below once you confirm the cap and remit details.
